title: Fig. 1  Data support and evaluation design (H$_2$-SimNet V2, manifest v0.2)
reason: PRELIMINARY (SCIENTIFIC REVIEW PENDING) - NOT A VALIDATED RESULT
units: runs, families (counts); windows (count, log scale); seconds
metric_definition: eligible runs and Scenario_Family_ID counts per class and topology; eligible 60 s / 30 s windows; window-start quantiles; pinned LOTO folds
limitations: three simulated topologies; 1 NORMAL, 1 DELAY and 1 FAULT family per topology (one independence group each across topologies); windows overlap and are not independent; DELAY windows only in the start-up segment; topology labels follow the release folders, whose Center/Downstream event attribution is disputed by the source simulation models (L12 / R-18, decision pending)
caption: Data support and evaluation design. (a) Eligible simulation runs per class in each simulated topology (label: runs/families); thin classes have one independent family per topology. (b) Eligible 60 s windows per class (log scale; share of all windows); windows overlap within runs and are not independent observations. (c) Start-time range, interquartile range and median of eligible windows: COMPRESSOR_DELAY occurs only in the start-up segment and is therefore confounded with operating phase. (d) Leave-one-topology-out evaluation: every model-development step uses the two training topologies only.
